CORS is limited to a single FRONTEND_URL env; acceptable for single-domain deployment but brittle across preview vs prod domains.

PortfolioInput.media_type is a free string; recommend Enum('reel','design') via Pydantic for stronger validation at the schema level (currently validated ad-hoc in create_item but NOT in update_item).
seed_data_creation: Created two temporary TEST_UI portfolio items during the browser flow; both cleaned up (one via UI delete, one via authenticated API DELETE).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All requested features/bugs verified end-to-end. seed_admin() is not called from startup; the admin exists because of prior seeding. If the DB is reset in a future iteration, main agent should await seed_admin() from the startup event.
rca of the issue: No blocking issue in this iteration. Note: seed_admin() function exists but is not invoked from the FastAPI startup event handler; only the email unique index is created. Currently non-blocking because the admin document already exists in the database.
